summary: Lance Walker of Baton Rouge, Louisiana, failed to return to camp on the evening of October 30 while hunting near Sand Creek on the northern side of Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve; his party triggered the SOS on a Garmin satellite device the next morning and his brother located him deceased in rough terrain, prompting a unified Saguache/Alamosa SAR and NPS response with 20+ personnel.
location: Sand Creek, northern side of Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR, Saguache County SAR, Chaffee County SAR-South, NPS/GRSA, Reach Air, DFPC Helitack
notes: Victim's brother found him deceased on Oct 31 after searching on foot; body recovered Nov 1 via technical rope work (four lowers, two raises) and DFPC Flat Iron Helitack after Reach Air inserted teams; helicopter assets unavailable on Oct 31 due to weather/winds; cause of death unknown; MVJ article parent-opened 2026-09-15. avsar.us missions index corroborates AVSAR's 2024-10-31 participation (overdue hunter near Mosca, joint with Saguache County SAR + Great Sand Dunes NPS) — the Lance Walker Sand Creek mission — run 578 Run 687 (Miner chunk): appended Mineral County Miner-hosted syndicated URL (same story id 65791 already on row via MVJ URL; source-append only — 894/2974 curation pair untouched).
